stages.implementation_note: run_cell_distributed.py (new driver, comm=/result=local, no full-sum gather) built and tested 2026-09-13 at 1/2/4 ranks with a monkeypatched passing preflight (this login host is not genoa) -- see decisions.md. E7 (a lower-tolerance run that exceeds single-node capacity) is NOT covered by this stage. E8 (schema.py's partition_row_policy field, decisions.md #21) is now implemented -- this sbatch template gained a PARTITION_ROW_POLICY env knob (default 'random', unchanged behavior) -- but the comm= path itself still has no explicit-rows plumbing, so this stage rejects PARTITION_ROW_POLICY=cut with a clear error rather than running it under a wrong label. A real 'cut' vs. 'random' E8 comparison at cluster scale needs either a campaign-genoa.sbatch variant that sets partitions=/partition_row_policy= (the in-process engine already supports both for real, validated locally at 32 qubits, decisions.md #21) or MPI-side explicit-rows plumbing; neither exists yet.

E7_attempt_2026-09-13T23:20:37Z.outcome: oom_crashed -- one rank (of 8) hit ~1.20 TiB RSS (343.84% above the 349 GiB average per seff), a node-level OOM, while total requested capacity (5.87 TiB) was only 46% utilized in aggregate
E7_attempt_2026-09-13T23:20:37Z.root_cause: genuine capacity/imbalance limit, NOT a code bug -- see decisions.md #22 for the full investigation (sacct/seff per-step MaxRSS/AveRSS, backtrace re-read, collective-order re-verification, term-count extrapolation). --mem/UCX config confirmed equivalent to the proven scripts/slurm/mpi-ranks.sbatch template; no fix applied to run_cell_distributed.py or campaign-genoa-distributed.sbatch since neither has a bug.
E7_attempt_2026-09-13T23:20:37Z.fallback_if_still_oom: --nodes=16 next, or drop to eps=2^-19 (MIN_ABS_COEFF=1.9073486e-06) as a real (less ambitious) E7 capacity point rather than a repeated crash at 2^-20

E7_result_2026-09-14.outcome: completed -- wall_time_s=1658.8, peak_terms=8923556570, peak_rss_kb~3.04 TiB summed across ranks (double a single genoa node's 1.5 TiB), a genuine beyond-single-node-capacity result. Doubling ranks vs the 7032060 attempt spread the same random partition-row draw thin enough that no single rank's share tipped it into OOM. evidence.md E7 moved blocked -> real data.

stages.implementation_note: run_cell_julia.py built and tested 2026-09-13: reuses run_cell._build_circuit/_build_observable and common.oracles to translate the engine's Circuit/PauliSum into task-JSON schema v1, then benchmarks/python/julia_baseline.py (make_task/run_task) to invoke benchmarks/julia/runner.jl. Real local proof at 8 qubits/1 step passed analysis/validate_campaign.py with 0 problems (decisions.md #20). Never writes a gate trace (trace_enabled=False always) -- PauliPropagation.jl has no per-gate wall-time instrumentation (decision #10); per-layer term counts land in the run record's extra.per_layer_terms instead. schema.py's engine enum, config_id and policy fields were fixed as part of this (decisions.md #20) -- real mismatches found by running validate_campaign.py against real output, same pattern as decision #17.
